arguments.sql:
SELECT 
    c.country, 
    SUM(o.total) / 100.0 AS revenue
FROM orders o
JOIN customers c ON o.customer_id = c.id
WHERE o.status = 'paid'
  AND o.order_date >= '2026-01-01'
  AND o.order_date <= '2026-03-31'
GROUP BY c.country
ORDER BY revenue DESC
LIMIT 1;
